why: Items 1, 2 and 4 are met. Item 1: builder step 7 says "Run npm install at the repo root so package-lock.json includes the new workspace". Item 2: builder step 6 says "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Item 4: Check 6 uses gh pr view (body, headRefOid) and requires the workflow at the head commit to be successful. Item 3 is not met. The verifier's only check that the root npm test really runs the jsonl-lint tests, plus the mutation test, sit under "Advisory (not pass/fail conditions)". Check 6 passes as long as the root npm test passes, which would still happen if --if-present skipped the tests. Check 4 runs npm test inside the workspace, not at the root. So no pass/fail check would catch the tests being skipped under the root npm test.
